scientific_queries.note: Power increase for the BATCHIE dose-aware residual test.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round spends its effort on statistical power rather than a new idea, which is what the previous round's width demanded.

compute.speedup: gene features were being rebuilt inside the repeat loop in R88; hoisting them made a 5x repeat count affordable

what_was_bought.point_estimate_stable: +2.81 pp became +2.42 pp with five times the units, so it is not a sampling accident
what_was_bought.interval_halved: CI width fell from 17.3 pp to 7.3 pp
what_was_bought.what_can_now_be_said: if the annotation model has any gain on BATCHIE residuals it is below about 6 pp
what_was_bought.what_still_cannot_be_said: that it has a gain, because the interval still contains zero

serious_weakness: held-out cells are drawn with replacement within a layout, so units are not independent and this CI is narrower than nominal, i.e. optimistic; the fact that it still fails to reach significance therefore strengthens rather than weakens the negative
limits: units are not independent (see the weakness note)
each drug still has only a few concentration points
only 12 cells, and only about a dozen layout clusters
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: more layouts, not more repeats, would be needed; BATCHIE's 21 high-diversity layouts are exhausted

register_updates.C62: new: still undetermined but the gain is bounded below 6 pp
